title: Degram
tagline: Degram is a decentralized social media platform. By utilizing Web 3 Storage solutions provided by IPFS (InterPlanetary File System), degram aims to provide users with a privacy-focused and adfree
description:
We are solving the social connectivity and privacy concerns that are currently the major issue over the cemtralized social media platform , As our platform does’nt has any centralized servers in order to store users data instead we use decentralized storage solution like Web3 storage by IPFS it enhances user provacy by protecting their data from being leaked , tampered, copied or exploitation . It also enhanxes user experience as we don’t store user data we won’t be using advertisements over our platform hence enhancing the user experience
